m-chesapeake.summary: Ran three full runs under a tight budget. unet_small at 5 epochs reached 0.566 mIoU, and unet_medium at 6 epochs reached 0.555, so the larger model gave no gain at that length. unet_small at 10 epochs, lr 2e-3, reached 0.607 mIoU (pixel accuracy 0.852). I selected it. Validation was still rising near the end of training, so longer schedules would likely help further if budget allowed.
